751-2079-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3499-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-6529.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-6529.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2921-3413-5929.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3310-5929-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
3310-5929-7855.description:
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Leyline of Transformation, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3151-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-6965.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2816-4668-7070.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
2816-4668-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat.

586-3967-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3585-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3585-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

893-4853-5686.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

3094-3649-6924.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3094-3649-6924.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, removing a flim counter from it and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

3490-4871-5256-6829.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

539-2511-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2450-4613-5643-6586.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You've had a Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2450-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Geralf triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Whim of Volrath spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat.

3908-6575.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Esper Terra that isn't legendary. This will cause it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter as it will be a Saga.
Spark Double's first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Spark Double with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste that isn't legendary and with one to four lore counters on it.
The Spark Double token's chapter abilities will trigger according to how many lore counters were placed on it.
Resolve the first Spark Double trigger, creating a token copy of Spark Double with haste, which will enter as a copy of Esper Terra with haste that isn't legendary and with one to four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

224-907-1772-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

5881-6077.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls exactly one creature.
Anzrag does not have summoning sickness.
5881-6077.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{G}{G}{R}{R}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Darksteel Mutation for {1}{W} targeting the only creature an opponent controls.
Resolve Darksteel Mutation, turning the enchanted creature into a 0/1 Insect artifact creature with indestructible.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking the opponent who controls the enchanted creature.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag with the enchanted creature, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.

1461-4050-4078-4506.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-4506.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

539-2034-4862-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle and Omanth's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Omnath's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Omnath trigger, creating a 5/5 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the second Omnath trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elemental dies, Omanth's second ability triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2868-5147-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2868-5147-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing damage equal to Lazotep Convert's power to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

948-2060-2433-3334-3545.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-3334-3545.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Lae'zel.
When the Ooze enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it due to Lae'zel.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Oozes with a +1/+1 counter on them, you may remove those counters to create an infinitely large Ooze using Ooze Flux.

224-1525-3703-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-3703-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Sporemound trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger(s), creating that many 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat.

1371-1827-1927-3765.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Vampiric Tutor.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Vampiric Tutor, causing them to search their library for a card, put it on top of their library and lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining opponent.

186-2734-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-2734-4131.description:
Cast Cyberdrive Awakener by paying {5}{U}.
Cyberdrive Awakener enters the battlefield, causing all noncreature artifacts you control to become 4/4 artifact creatures until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

2440-2871-3581.notablePrerequisites: Two additional spirits on the battlefield.
2440-2871-3581.description:
Pay {3}{R} to cast Seething Anger with buyback, giving target creature +3/+0 untill end of turn.
Kykar triggers, creating a spirit.
On ETB, the spirit triggers Mana Echoes, generating {3}.
Sacrifice the spirit to Kykar to generate {R}.
Repeat.

651-2849-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Cast Sheltering Word targeting Task Force, gaining life equal to its toughness.
